description: This Java class defines a custom exception handler for a GUI application, displaying exception details in a dialog and logging them to a file.

classes.name: DefaultExceptionHandler
classes.description: Handles uncaught exceptions in a Java Swing application, displays the exception info in a dialog, and logs the error.

methods.name: uncaughtException
methods.description: Handles uncaught exceptions by delegating to handleException method.

methods.name: handleException
methods.description: Processes the Throwable, logs it, and displays error details in a GUI dialog.

methods.name: findActiveFrame
methods.description: Returns the currently visible JFrame to be used as parent for dialogs.
